title: 美好的校园时光 · Campus Days
summary: 100-frame FLUX.2 storyboard: arrival, classes, sports, library, seasons, friendship, festivals, exams, graduation.

flux2_notes.language: English prompts for Mistral TE; UI titles in Chinese.
flux2_notes.style: Natural full sentences; subject first; positive wording; no negative prompt.
flux2_notes.workflow: examples/flux2-dev-t2i.json via catalog flux2-dev on RTX-PRO-6000.

frames.title: 校门晨曦
frames.text: A wide establishing shot of an East Asian university gate at dawn, pale gold sunlight cutting through morning mist, fresh green plane trees lining the stone path, a few students in navy blazers walking uphill with backpacks, soft cinematic lighting, photorealistic, 24mm landscape still.

frames.title: 单车入校
frames.text: A teenage boy in a white shirt and navy blazer rides a bicycle through the open campus gate, wind lifting his tie slightly, cherry blossom petals drifting across the frame, warm side light, documentary photography, 35mm film still, sharp focus.

frames.title: 樱花大道
frames.text: Two friends, a girl and a boy in matching school uniforms, walk together under blooming cherry trees on campus, pink petals falling like snow, they laugh while holding iced coffee cups, shallow depth of field, golden morning glow, photorealistic editorial portrait.

frames.title: 公告栏前

frames.title: 教学楼台阶

frames.title: 新生问路
